final: SELECT r.ordervault, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / totals.total_count AS quotient FROM riskandmargin AS r CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault)) AS totals WHERE r.ordervault IS NOT NULL AND totals.total_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ordervault, totals.total_count ORDER BY quotient DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
